steps.name: witch of deception
steps.objective: Take a peek at someone’s conversation at the entrance to “Amaranth Nova.” Then click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.text: (Belial sighs after discovering something fallen from the ruined temple in Amaranth Nova, which has turned colorless.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Phew, I didn't know that the God of Despair that I worked so hard on for so long would end up like that... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Kaulini, it's unfortunate, but I guess there's nothing we can do. Still, I will find out if there is a way to resurrect you in the demon world.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: What if that doesn’t work? You have to think and accept that this is the end for you.
(Belial picks up the remains of the black butterfly and the broken weapon fragments from the floor and throws them into the mirror.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: What are you? rabbit?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You were here. Demon of deception.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I've been watching you since a while ago.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe, you knew it, but you moved calmly.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I would have asked what your name was.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: My name is Daphne.
(The moment he hears Daphne's name, Belial is surprised and looks at him with interest.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: That ‘Daphne’?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe, it's funny that a witch known as the worst in the demon world came to visit me. Okay, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I have something I want to do. I don't know if you know, but if you want to see that old man. I need your help.
(Daphne smiles brightly, sneaks up to Belial, raises her staff, and lightly taps Belial on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This makes you the ‘last’ of my work. It’s an honor, Belial… .

steps.name: Confessions of the Black Moon
steps.objective: Take a peek at someone’s conversation in “The Nameless Place” in “Elysia.” Then click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Are you here, Hilda?
(Hilda looks around and is surprised to find Hecate standing in front of her.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hecate? Then this is Elysia… impression?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Wasn't I dead? Hecate, speak. How did this happen... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I'm sorry if I brought you here without permission.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Originally, your soul was supposed to perish, but your will to regenerate saved you.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: But the body disappeared and could not return.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So what happened to that guy in Amaranth Nova? Am I not helpful?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No. you were helpful Through %s's performance and Iris's awakening, the demon Kaulini was defeated... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank goodness… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: That was exactly what Ouroboros, who joined hands with the old man, hoped for. Swallow your soul before it disappears... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I don't even know what that means... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Sigh, Iris, that child's luggage should have come to me... . I had to quickly free you from the witch's burden... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: So many souls have been lost to my weakness and the old man's pranks.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The thing that threatened me and that guy... , Iris The goddess was also asked to give up her position as the star god... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I understand now... . I'm sorry for being angry all this time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I vaguely knew it. My world may have already been destroyed.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I guess the demon God Caulini didn't feel that, and was satisfied with throwing me into a world line that didn't exist anymore... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Now that I’m gone, he’ll feel more comfortable too… . Let me tell you a little faster... . It was destined to end up like this anyway.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No… . Your fate is by no means hopeless.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I was just thrown into a black curtain that no one knows about... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Like Iris and that child… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: And just like you and me... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: And just like you who tried to save the world of despair even in times of destruction... .
